content: She nods. “I wouldn’t expect him not to. I also bet the discussions got tiresome.”
She nods looking tired just thinking back on it "I do hope to see you around more."
“I mean, it depends if I swing by the Golden Voice later.” With that she gives a bow to Vivica. “Thank you. I’ll sign my support now.”
Vivica smiles and bows her head slightly as Secel as she leaves
She makes her way to the floor of the hall.
Secel makes her way through the crowd, then taps Finn on the shoulder from behind.

He turns around and steps away from the group of the fey council
"Secel! I'm glad you could join us!"
“I hope I’m not interrupting anything.” She smiles at him. “How much support have you gotten from the people?”
Ed hops in, briefly looks around and walks over to start  reading the document with a face of deep concentration as they do so.
"Oh no, this has been going on for awhile. We're bouncing everywhere. Currently we have about nine signatures"
“Make it ten. Your co-author convinced me.”

He smiles
"We appreciate the your support. It means a great amount. Moments like this make the past days of debates worth it"
(gonna have to wait to rp as the council until late tonight, apologies)
(no worries. I might be available but not too late tonight unfortunately)
“I bet they weren’t enjoyable.” She signs her support. “I’m also surprised that nobody asked about beings like dragons and others that might want to be part of our country.”
"It seems most people were concerned with wardens and gods not being included in shaping the system"
a brass dragonborn leans in "dragons are usually more reasonable, divine stuff is complicated"
“Exactly.” She nods. “Your co-author was also very transparent about the fact that nobody asked such a question about beings other than the gods and the wardens.”

He smiles
"She is quite the amazing partner"
“I can’t see why not.” She then looks around. “I hope I’m not holding you up.”

"Well really it's just about what you're willing to risk, you always sacrifice something when you put something in place, like speed, or reliability, or creativity all that mumbo jumbo. Anything can go poorly when you look at it juuuust right."
"Oh no you're fine Secel, just making rounds. I think with the session ending tonight at midnight, we won't have another chance to collect where support is going."
"It'll always be a balancing game, that's for sure"
"Okay. I hope it all goes well for the constitution."
"Me too"
Vivica goes back to going through the stands encouraging voters and answering any questions the people have
"How close are you expecting the results to be?"

the dragonborn gives one last whisper "just don't let the suit guy call the shot, that's just another revolution waiting to happen and I think a lot more heads would roll on that one." before he turns and leaves
"Well, there's not a lot of options. It's really down to whether or not people believe in this Constitution. Otherwise the bribes of Vanderbilt will give him defacto power"
"I think there's a good amount, myself included that would join that revolution haha"
"Count me in on that one." Vivica calls from the stands
"The last thing we need is a revolution just after a war."
After finally finishing their read through, Ed will do their best to put a somewhat legible signature to support the document

Roy's visibly tired after observing all the arguing and reading the final draft. Even the long-legged bugs on his shoulders and arms seem out of energy by that point.
"For hope and unity, for life and freedom, may we be the people to make this dream a reality and have a home for us all."
And signs under the draft and the bill of rights:
*Roy Gat Lutom*
The dwarf pulls a feather from his wide brimmed cap. He dips it in a vial of cobalt ink. He takes a moment and thinks carefully. He then begins to write.
||HHWB|| is inscribed in a golden ink that then fades away into the paper.
The speaker writes in his own signature. He wishes to partake in the new nation no matter what.

Lucy beams in from a window... She flutters around the room squeeling in joy. She flies ofer to where the signatures are as her eyes begin to glow. "All right, where ya need my signature?" Bo's voice echoes.
Vivica beams at him "Dispite our differences I'm glad to see you take part in this, perhaps we can debate philosophies later."
Finn hands around the document to sign
Finn is energized by the support by the end

"The fact that we have differing opinions is a good reason for me to give my support, isn't differing views the reason why democracy was made." The Speaker says with a smile. "And we will definitely be debating philosophies later."
Vivica smiles "I look forward to it."
The speaker bows and heads back to the stands, eager to see the resolution of this event.

Lucy flies over to the bottle of ink and tips the tip of her tail in it. The sharp barb drips with ink a moment. She flutters over and uses her tail to write "Bo" before letting the ink drip into a small pool beside Bo's signature. Her eyes stop glowing and she squeals before pressing her paw down, leaving her pawprint where the pool of ink was. She starts flying in circles around the room and darts out of a window.
Lucy quickly flies back in and presses her paw on Malathor and Heore's forehead, leaving her mark on them. She giggles before beaming back outside like a rainbow rocket.
Demetrius closes his eyes for a little while before opening them again and nodding to Sutri.
Eliot makes his way into the hall nervously, his hands fidgeting heavily as he talks quietly with Willow, the red panda draped over his shoulder.
Vivica recognizes Eliot and gives him a friendly wave

She will hand him a copy of the midaskian  government proposal "Its good to see you again. We're making a vote on our new form of government for after the war, it between this and Vanderbuilts proposal. If you have any questions, I'll be happy to discuss them with you."
Eliot meekly returns the waves and nods as he takes the paper with shaking hands. "O-okay..."
Vivica will do her best not to crowd Eliot, but will stay nearby incase he has questions.

Simply because she's in the mood for it, she's spent the past few hours organizing her thoughts with her ravens, Irynx takes to the soapbox.

"Arcanians, all of you, my name is Irynx Berlio and I am asking you to sign. A stroke of a pen to set the stones of what will be our brand new nation.

No. Not stones.

"There was a saying, when I was a young girl. 'When the rain comes, hearts of stone will wear away and hearts of iron will rust, but hearts of clay will blossom and bloom.' We build not stone or iron, but soil and clay. We are not crafting a sword, but tending to a garden. Delicate work, careful work, beautiful.

"Freedom is red, and war is its price. It is one we will fight to pay for the possibility of a nation. When we are free, what better weight to replace the rifles on our shoulders with the heads of those who have lost in pain?

"I believe the proposal Captain Midask and Miss Catla is what makes this possible. This, the United States of Arcania, the Empire of Refuge and Comfort. An hour remains to dig the foundation. Arcanians, all of you, I ask you to sign."

There's a moment of quiet as she reaches the end of her speech, then squeaks in embarassment. In a flash of white feathers, she turns into a raven and flies off into the stands.
Vivica goes to Irynx "That was beautifully said. You have been a tremendous help to us with this proposal and throughout the debates entirely. I'm very happy to call you a friend."

Eliot finishes his read through and looks around to for Vivica to ask a question, but finds his answer before finding her. 

He makes his way over to where the signatures are being taken and takes hold of the quill, his hand shaking violently as he goes to write his name. Willow bites into his arm, and rather than recoiling in pain Eliot utters a quiet thank you as it seems to calm his hand long enough to sign his name is a beautiful script that falters on the last two letters. He quickly walks away, almost forgetting to leave the quill.
Vivica sees another signature has been added but misses the chance to thank Eliot before he slips away
Eliot makes his way quietly over to Demetrius, his hands fidgeting once more. "Ex-excuse me? Mr. Demetrius?" He asks meekly, his voice barely above a whisper and easily lost in the din of the hall.
Demetrius looks down and smiles. "Eliot, my dear friend. What can I do for you?"

After a long while of thought and discussion Demetrius, Paddy, and Sutri will eventually sign though the twins will refuse. "I'm sorry Mr Midask." Says Prosser. "We respect what you're doing, we really do. But one government for all of Arcania seems like too much power, even if it is divided up as elegantly as you've portrayed it. We... we have a lot of experience with that much power being used it hurtful ways." Trapero and Prosser look at each other, a painful memory flashing across their faces. "I do hope we can continue to work together to drive the redcoats out of our land and build a peaceful future for all of Arcania's peoples." They will both thank Finn and Vivica for their work and shake their hands before leaving, seeming stoic but clearly still remembering a painful memory. Their arms are wrapped around each other and are leaning on each other for mutual support.

Eliot has a hard time looking directly at Demetrius and continues to fidget as he reaches into his pocket. "I-I was g-going to write you tomorrow... there was... is... there *is* something I wanted to ask you about, but this.... not the place... ummm sorry... if you're not busy... tomorrow could you come by the c-cafè? S-so we can talk... ummm but I know you're import- important so if you're to busy..." He  holds out an unlabeled envelope towards Demetrius as he tries to fight the shaking of his hands.
Lucy squeaks as she perches up on the window sill. She purs as she watches everyone from the outside of the window.

Demetrius nods and smiles. "Of course, Eliot. I will read this letter and I hope to visit you tomorrow." He reaches down and ruffles your hair pleasantly, in a somewhat fatherly way. 
After he does so, Sutri walks over to you. "It's good to see you here." he smiles (has eliot met sutri/know who they are? completely up to you if he has)

Vivica is happy to see the new signatures from those of Fey court and she will thank them all for the vote. She will of course give a smile to the twins and bid them a good evening and thank them for hearing what they had to say.

"T-the letter is j-just a cond- cond- a quick version of what I wanted to t-talk  to you about. So you didn't have to come by.... busy 'n all..." Eliot rambles softly but nods regardless. 
"G‐Good to see you too M-Mx. Sutri. It's b-been a while. M-Matteo and D-Despo miss the kids. Y-you sh-should stop by some time." Eliot manages to say as his fidgeting worsens again before Willow bops his head with her paw.
(sutri is nb just an fyi)

They nod. "I'd love to! Things have been hectic recently, but I think it would do a lot of them good." Sutri smiles. "Speaking of, I should get back. But I'd love to chat sometime just you and me, maybe discuss our shared benefactor or just have tea." They reach over towards willow. "May I?" they ask Willow (who will fully understand them)

Willow coos and offers her head towards the offered hand.

Eliot nods. "M-my d-door is always open. W-we should be going too..."
Sutri will give willow gentle pets then nod. "We're headed in the same direction, would you care to walk back together?"
Eliot nods to Sutri quite eagerly before turning back to Demetrius and giving a large formal bow, despite his shaking.
Demetrius returns the bow and Sutri will head out with Eliot towards <#852739507647545364>
Lucy flies in and jumps around the room, she hops up in front of Vivica and her tongue 'blmps' out of her mouth like a gecko as she smiles.
Vivica smiles at Lucy and gives her a pat on the head
She sits back in a nearby chair and gives a great sigh, "Voting is closed, whatever happens now, it's left to the numbers. I hope we got enough signatures.."
Lucy nuzzles Vivica as she purrs

Demetrius will congratulate Vivica on all her hard work and give a bow. "I am glad to see you were able to expand upon the topics i had questions about." He pauses for a moment. "Would you care for some tea? What you did is quite stressful indeed and i believe i have just the blend that could help."
Still holding Lucy in her lap, "I would love some tea thank you." She bows her head to Demetrius

Lucy's ears jolt up. She squeals as she leaps away from Vivica's lap and flies around the room, encircling Demetrius before stoping right in front his face. She smiles, purrs, and boops his nose before flying around with giggling noises.

He nods and waves his hand as a nearby chair and table move over so you both may sit down. He claps twice and a pot of hot tea appears, freshly steaming. He pours you a cup and sits down before offering Lucy a skritch or two and a small biscuit. "Don't worry it's good for you." he says to the dragon

Lucy sniffs it before slowly taking it with her mouth. She flies around him quickly before landing on his shoulder, nibbling at the biscuit. She nuzzles his cheek before flying up to the rafters for a small nap.

Vivica watches Lucy "I will be glad to get back to my regular life once we know the result of this vote. However, we do still have a war to win."  She takes a sip of the tea, "wow this is really good."
Multiple colors beam up, shining on the ceiling above as Lucy can be heard squeeling in joy as she finishes the biscuit. She spins around on the rafters before settling into a comfy spot.

He nods and sips his own cup. "It's a blend of my own devising. The plants are from the feywild but are close approximations to lavender, mint, and rose." He chuckles a little bit to himself, as the petals making up his suit flutter.
"I would like to see the Feywild one day, I think. My parents used to tell me stories of it when I was little."

He nods sadly. "There's a lot of people around here who'd like to. But all the portals we can find are one-way. Whether by accident, exile, or wanderlust, many of the fey here came from the wild and are now stuck." He smiles sadly.
She nods "Maybe after everything has calmed down and the war is over we can look for a way for people to return?"

He sighs. "I would like that, though i'm not sure yet if it's possible. I've been looking for a reliable way back for beings other than myself for a very long time and as of yet have been unsuccessful.
She leans back in her chair "If I ever get any leads I'll let you know.  I'd like to think I'm a pretty good detective when I want to be."
He smiles. "I would greatly appreciate that."

Once she finishes her tea she will stand and give Demetrius a small bow. "I think its time for some rest, this battle is done and while we wait for the results, we will need to prepare for the battles ahead of us. The tea was lovely, and I would like to thank you again for the support. I hope to see you around more."
Vivica will say her goodbyes and thank those who supported the constitution that Finn and her drafted  before heading home to await the results there.
The song of the brunelock plays as those gathered around him watch the flag of roanoke fall from the form that was once a dwarf into a flag once again.
The Mender gets up and quietly exits
Demetrius will thank Vivica and leave as well
